# Security Policy

**Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues, discussions or pull requests.**

## Supported Versions

Only the latest major version receives security fixes.

| Version | Supported |
|---|---|
| 1.x | ✅ |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Report vulnerabilities privately through GitHub:

1. Open the [Security tab](https://github.com/GuNNeR42/laravel-eet-module/security) of the repository.
2. Click **Report a vulnerability** ([direct link](https://github.com/GuNNeR42/laravel-eet-module/security/advisories/new)).
3. Describe the issue, the affected versions and, if possible, the steps to reproduce it.

Only the maintainer can see the report. You will get a reply in the advisory thread; once a fix is released, the advisory is published and you are credited unless you ask otherwise.

Never include real certificates, private keys, passwords or production data of a taxpayer in the report; use the EET playground certificates or redacted values instead.
